law.note: The scattering law the cubes are normalised with: W7's fit (public/data/mars/photometry.json, 2026-10-03) to Mallama & Hilton (2018) Eq. 6 with the W3 part 2 map. Pinned here so the map and the fit that follows it are not circular; the refit on the corrected map is reported in the story.
